result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 server dispatch passes the same RequestContext<RoleServer> into tasks/update and tasks/cancel. In handle_request, UpdateTaskRequest calls self.update_task(request.params, context) and CancelTaskRequest calls self.cancel_task(request.params, context). The ServerHandler methods update_task(UpdateTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>) and cancel_task(CancelTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>) therefore directly expose the generic request context to concrete task handlers. Combined with the prior exact-release finding that RequestContext.meta is public RequestMetaObject, custom inbound request _meta can be inspected directly inside these task handlers rather than being lost at method dispatch.
